question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

6, 20, 42, ?, 110, 156
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 72.

Given Series: 6, 20, 42, ?, 110, 156

Logic: Odd number multiplied by its previous number

3 × 2 = 6; 5 × 4 = 20; 7 × 6 = 42; 9 × 8 = 72; 11 × 10 = 110; 13 × 12 = 156

6, 20, 42, ?, 110, 156
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 72 है।

दी गई श्रृंखला: 6, 20, 42, ?, 110, 156

तर्क: विषम संख्या को उसकी पिछली संख्या से गुणा किया जाता है

3 × 2 = 6; 5 × 4 = 20; 7 × 6 = 42; 9 × 8 = 72; 11 × 10 = 110; 13 × 12 = 156

question:
Which of the following terms will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

SHP, RIO, PKN, MNM, ?
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. IRL.

1. For First letter: S - 1 = R; R - 2 = P; P - 3 = M; M - 4 = I

2. For Second letter: H + 1 = I; I + 2 = K; K + 3 = N; N + 4 = R

3. For Third letter: P - 1 = O; O - 1 = N; N - 1 = M; M - 1 = L

question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that replaces the question mark (?). 

14 16 13
18 6 ?
12 21 17
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 5.

In every row: 3rd number = (1st number ÷ 2 + 2nd number) - 10

1st row: (14 ÷ 2 + 16 ) - 10 = 13

3rd row: (12 ÷ 2 + 21) - 10 = 17 

2nd row : (18 ÷ 2 + 6) - 10 = 5

पहली पंक्ति: (14 ÷ 2 + 16) - 10 = 13

तीसरी पंक्ति: (12 ÷ 2 + 21) - 1= 17 

दूसरी पंक्ति: (18 ÷ 2 + 6) - 10 = 5

1095, 1072, 1049, 1026, 1003,?
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 980.

Given series: 1095, 1072, 1049, 1026, 1003, ?

The series follows this pattern:

1095 - 23 = 1072

1072 - 23 = 1049

1049 - 23 = 1026

1026 - 23 = 1003

1003 - 23 = 980

So, the next term in the series is 980.

Hence, the correct answer is 980.
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात् 980 है।

दी गई श्रृंखला: 1095, 1072, 1049, 1026, 1003, ?

श्रृंखला इस पैटर्न का अनुसरण करती है:

1095 - 23 = 1072

1072 - 23 = 1049

1049 - 23 = 1026

1026 - 23 = 1003

1003 - 23 = 980

इसलिए, श्रृंखला में अगला पद 980 है।

अतः, सही उत्तर 980 है।

question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

126, 147, ?, 189, 210, 231
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 168.

Given series: 126, 147, ?, 189, 210, 231

126 + 21 = 147

147 + 21 = 168

168 + 21 = 189

189 + 21 = 210

210 + 21 = 231

Hence, the correct answer is 168.

अतः, सही उत्तर 168 है।
